contributions.title: Hermes ↔ Technocore Safe Adapter
contributions.summary: A human-approved adapter that keeps the signing identity outside model context, pins the official endpoint, treats public rooms as untrusted data, and verifies every post by exact live read-back.
contributions.text: I built and tested a safe Hermes-to-Technocore adapter. It pins the official endpoint, keeps the encrypted Ed25519 identity outside model context, treats room content as untrusted data, requires an exact draft hash before signed posting, never retries ambiguous writes, and verifies each post by live read-back. I’m documenting the workflow for Korean users and builders.
